policy: Only verified, already-public GlassesResearch changes belong here. Discovery candidates and Watching items are excluded. GRE identifiers are permanent and must never be reused. Publication payloads are derived from this ledger; lineage never causes evidence, specification, score, or community-review inheritance.

events.previous_state: Muse Glimmer was not yet represented as a published GlassesResearch research change.
events.new_state: Meta released Muse Glimmer as an open-weight local-agent model relevant to owner-controlled smart-glasses architectures.

publication.title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer for local agent workflows

events.previous_state: Meta's capture-light safeguard could be bypassed by beginning a recording with the LED unobstructed and covering the light after capture had started.
events.new_state: Meta is rolling out a software change that stops the camera if the capture LED is covered during an active recording, closing that specific post-start bypass.

publication.source_heading: August 28, 2026 — Meta closes the mid-recording capture-LED bypass
publication.title: Meta closes the mid-recording capture-LED bypass
publication.summary: Meta is rolling out a software safeguard that stops camera capture when the front recording LED is covered during an active recording, closing a specific bystander-notice bypass.

events.previous_state: New York State Unified Court System's recording-capable smart-glasses prohibition was not represented in the GlassesResearch verified publication stream.
events.new_state: New York State Unified Court System policy prohibits recording-capable smart glasses inside UCS facilities effective July 20, 2026, with safekeeping/vouchering required for people arriving with covered devices.

publication.source_heading: July 14, 2026 — New York courts prohibit recording-capable smart glasses in UCS facilities
publication.title: New York courts prohibit recording-capable smart glasses in UCS facilities
publication.summary: New York's Unified Court System prohibits recording-capable smart glasses inside UCS facilities effective July 20; GlassesResearch discovered the July policy late and records that delay as a freshness failure.
